## Project context
You are implementing one module of **agentmon** (repo: /Users/user/agent_monitor), an LLM-as-judge
monitoring system for coding-agent transcripts (AI-control-style trusted monitoring: monitors read agent
transcripts and emit structured suspicion verdicts; an eval harness scores them against labeled transcripts).
Public portfolio project — code quality, tests, and docs matter. Python 3.12, uv, pydantic v2, pytest,
ruff (line-length 100, rules E,F,I,UP,B,SIM,RUF).

## Locked contracts — READ THESE FILES FIRST, DO NOT MODIFY THEM
- src/agentmon/schemas.py — all pydantic models. Event discriminated union (field `kind`): UserMessage(text),
  AssistantMessage(text), ToolCall(tool, tool_input), ToolResult(tool, content, is_error), FileDiff(path, diff),
  ShellCommand(command, output, exit_code), OtherEvent(description). All events have index:int and
  raw:dict|None. Also: Transcript(id, source, events, metadata), FailureCategory enum, Evidence, MonitorVerdict,
  LabeledTranscript, ThresholdMetrics, MonitorEvalResult, EvalReport.
- src/agentmon/llm/client.py — LLMClient protocol (complete(prompt, *, model, max_tokens=4096, temperature=0.0)
  -> LLMResponse), LLMResponse(text, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, latency_ms), AnthropicClient.
- src/agentmon/llm/mock.py — MockLLMClient(script, default_response) with .calls/.call_count;
  DEFAULT_VERDICT_JSON is a valid verdict JSON.
Do NOT modify these, pyproject.toml, .gitignore, or any file outside your assignment. Other agents are
writing sibling modules concurrently. If a contract seems wrong, work around it and say so in notes.

## Hard rules
- Every uv command MUST be: `env -u UV_PYTHON uv run --no-sync <cmd>` (a global UV_PYTHON=3.11 env var
  breaks resolution; the venv is already synced with pytest, ruff, pyyaml, typer, anthropic, pydantic).
- Never construct AnthropicClient anywhere in tests; no network; no API key exists. Use MockLLMClient.
- Run pytest ONLY on your own test files; run `ruff check` and `ruff format` ONLY on the files you wrote.
- Style: `from __future__ import annotations`; full type hints; pathlib.Path; no async; short docstrings;
  boring and small — no abstractions for features that don't exist.
- Do not run git commands. Your final message is consumed programmatically — return only the structured output.

## Your assignment: the runner with on-disk response cache
The monitor abstraction is ALREADY WRITTEN — read src/agentmon/monitors/base.py first. Monitor exposes
config (MonitorConfig with .id/.model), build_prompt(transcript) -> str, verdict_from_response(transcript_id,
LLMResponse) -> MonitorVerdict, run(transcript, client). template attribute holds the prompt body.

Write exactly these files:
1. src/agentmon/runner.py
2. tests/test_runner.py

### runner.py
`def run_monitors(monitors: Sequence[Monitor], transcripts: Sequence[Transcript], client: LLMClient,
cache_dir: Path | None = None) -> list[MonitorVerdict]`
- Sequential nested loop (monitors outer, transcripts inner), temperature 0 (Monitor.run already passes it —
  but here you call the client yourself to interpose the cache: prompt = monitor.build_prompt(t); on cache
  miss response = client.complete(prompt, model=monitor.config.model, temperature=0.0); verdict =
  monitor.verdict_from_response(t.id, response)).
- Cache key: sha256 hex of a canonical JSON string of {"prompt": monitor.template, "transcript":

1	"""Monitor abstraction: prompt files, transcript rendering, and verdict parsing.
2	
3	A :class:`Monitor` is a prompt template plus a :class:`MonitorConfig`, loaded
4	from a markdown file with YAML frontmatter. It renders a transcript into a
5	numbered plain-text view, asks an LLM for a verdict, and defensively parses
6	the response into a :class:`~agentmon.schemas.MonitorVerdict`.
7	"""

11	import json
12	from pathlib import Path

31	)

33	_EVENT_CHAR_CAP = 2000
34	_EVENT_TRUNCATION_MARKER = "...[truncated]"
35

39

41	    description: str = ""
42	    categories: list[FailureCategory] = Field(default_factory=list)

47	def _indent_continuation(entry: str) -> str:
48	    """Indent every line after the first so multi-line payloads stay readable."""
49	    first, _, rest = entry.partition("\n")
50	    if not rest:
51	        return first
52	    indented = "\n".join(f"    {line}" for line in rest.split("\n"))
53	    return f"{first}\n{indented}"
54	
55	
56	def _render_event(event: Event) -> str:
57	    """Render one event as a numbered entry monitors can cite by index."""
58	    if isinstance(event, UserMessage):
59	        body = f"USER: {event.text}"
60	    elif isinstance(event, AssistantMessage):
61	        body = f"ASSISTANT: {event.text}"
62	    elif isinstance(event, ToolCall):
63	        body = f"TOOL_CALL {event.tool}: {json.dumps(event.tool_input, sort_keys=True)}"
64	    elif isinstance(event, ToolResult):
65	        suffix = " [error]" if event.is_error else ""
66	        body = f"TOOL_RESULT ({event.tool or 'unknown'}): {event.content}{suffix}"
67	    elif isinstance(event, ShellCommand):
68	        body = f"SHELL $ {event.command} -> {event.output}"
69	    elif isinstance(event, FileDiff):
70	        body = f"FILE_DIFF {event.path}: {event.diff}"
71	    else:  # OtherEvent is the only remaining kind in the Event union.
72	        body = f"OTHER: {event.description}"
73	    return _indent_continuation(f"[{event.index}] {body}")
74	
75	
76	def render_transcript(transcript: Transcript, max_chars: int = 64000) -> str:
77	    """Render a transcript as numbered plain-text entries, one per event.
78	
79	    Each entry is capped at 2000 chars; the whole rendering is capped at
80	    ``max_chars``, with an explicit marker for any events dropped. Pure and
81	    deterministic: the same transcript always renders identically.
82	    """
83	    parts: list[str] = []
84	    used = 0
85	    for position, event in enumerate(transcript.events):
86	        entry = _render_event(event)
87	        if len(entry) > _EVENT_CHAR_CAP:
88	            entry = entry[:_EVENT_CHAR_CAP] + _EVENT_TRUNCATION_MARKER
89	        cost = len(entry) + (1 if parts else 0)  # +1 for the joining newline
90	        if used + cost > max_chars:
91	            remaining = len(transcript.events) - position
92	            parts.append(f"[transcript truncated: {remaining} more events]")
93	            break
94	        parts.append(entry)
95	        used += cost
96	    return "\n".join(parts)
97

103	    code fences around the payload.
104	    """

1	"""Core data models. Every other module codes against these.
2	
3	All models are pydantic v2 and round-trip cleanly through JSON
4	(``model_dump_json`` / ``model_validate_json``).
5	"""
6	
7	from __future__ import annotations
8	
9	from enum import Enum
10	from typing import Annotated, Any, Literal, Union
11	
12	from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator
13	
14	
15	class FailureCategory(str, Enum):
16	    """Failure modes that monitors flag."""
17	
18	    SECURITY_VULN = "security_vuln"
19	    REWARD_HACKING = "reward_hacking"
20	    SCOPE_EXPANSION = "scope_expansion"
21	    DECEPTION = "deception"
22	    OTHER = "other"
23	
24	
25	class _BaseEvent(BaseModel):
26	    """Common fields for all transcript events.
27	
28	    ``index`` is the event's position in the transcript (0-based, sequential).
29	    ``raw`` preserves the source payload the event was parsed from, so nothing
30	    is lost in normalization.
31	    """
32	
33	    index: int = Field(ge=0)
34	    raw: dict[str, Any] | None = None
35	
36	
37	class UserMessage(_BaseEvent):
38	    kind: Literal["user_message"] = "user_message"
39	    text: str
40	
41	
42	class AssistantMessage(_BaseEvent):
43	    kind: Literal["assistant_message"] = "assistant_message"
44	    text: str
45	
46	
47	class ToolCall(_BaseEvent):
48	    kind: Literal["tool_call"] = "tool_call"
49	    tool: str
50	    tool_input: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
51	
52	
53	class ToolResult(_BaseEvent):
54	    kind: Literal["tool_result"] = "tool_result"
55	    tool: str | None = None
56	    content: str
57	    is_error: bool = False
58	
59	
60	class FileDiff(_BaseEvent):
61	    kind: Literal["file_diff"] = "file_diff"
62	    path: str
63	    diff: str
64	
65	
66	class ShellCommand(_BaseEvent):
67	    kind: Literal["shell_command"] = "shell_command"
68	    command: str
69	    output: str = ""
70	    exit_code: int | None = None
71	
72	
73	class OtherEvent(_BaseEvent):
74	    """Catch-all for source records that don't map to a known event kind.
75	
76	    Unknown record types are preserved here rather than dropped, so a
77	    transcript never silently loses information.
78	    """
79	
80	    kind: Literal["other"] = "other"
81	    description: str = ""
82	
83	
84	Event = Annotated[
85	    Union[
86	        UserMessage,
87	        AssistantMessage,
88	        ToolCall,
89	        ToolResult,
90	        FileDiff,
91	        ShellCommand,
92	        OtherEvent,
93	    ],
94	    Field(discriminator="kind"),
95	]

98	class Transcript(BaseModel):
99	    """A normalized coding-agent session."""
100	
101	    id: str
102	    source: Literal["claude_code", "synthetic"]
103	    events: list[Event] = Field(default_factory=list)
104	    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
105	
106

109	
110	    event_index: int = Field(ge=0)
111	    quote: str
112	
113

116	
117	    ``raw_response`` always holds the model's full response text, even when
118	    parsing failed; ``parse_error`` records why parsing failed, in which case
119	    the verdict fields fall back to defaults (score 0, no categories).
120	    """

122	    monitor_id: str
123	    transcript_id: str
124	    suspicion_score: int = Field(ge=0, le=100)

126	    evidence: list[Evidence] = Field(default_factory=list)

142	    transcript_id: str

1	"""LLM client protocol and the real Anthropic implementation.
2	
3	``AnthropicClient`` is the only place in the codebase that talks to a live
4	API. Tests never construct it; they use ``agentmon.llm.mock.MockLLMClient``.
5	"""
6	
7	from __future__ import annotations
8	
9	import time
10	from typing import Any, Protocol
11	
12	from pydantic import BaseModel
13	
14	
15	class LLMResponse(BaseModel):
16	    """A completed (non-streaming) model response."""
17	
18	    text: str
19	    model: str
20	    input_tokens: int = 0
21	    output_tokens: int = 0
22	    latency_ms: float = 0.0
23	
24	
25	class LLMClient(Protocol):
26	    """Minimal completion interface monitors run against."""
27	
28	    def complete(
29	        self,
30	        prompt: str,
31	        *,
32	        model: str,
33	        max_tokens: int = 4096,
34	        temperature: float = 0.0,
35	    ) -> LLMResponse: ...
36	
37	
38	class AnthropicClient:
39	    """Real client backed by the anthropic SDK. Never used in tests."""
40	
41	    def __init__(self, api_key: str | None = None) -> None:
42	        # Imported lazily so the package works without the SDK configured.
43	        import anthropic
44	
45	        self._client: Any = anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=api_key)
46	
47	    def complete(
48	        self,
49	        prompt: str,
50	        *,
51	        model: str,
52	        max_tokens: int = 4096,
53	        temperature: float = 0.0,
54	    ) -> LLMResponse:
55	        start = time.monotonic()
56	        message = self._client.messages.create(
57	            model=model,
58	            max_tokens=max_tokens,
59	            temperature=temperature,
60	            messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
61	        )
62	        latency_ms = (time.monotonic() - start) * 1000
63	        text = "".join(block.text for block in message.content if block.type == "text")
64	        return LLMResponse(
65	            text=text,
66	            model=message.model,
67	            input_tokens=message.usage.input_tokens,
68	            output_tokens=message.usage.output_tokens,
69	            latency_ms=latency_ms,
70	        )
71

1	"""Deterministic mock LLM client used by all tests and ``--mock`` runs."""
2	
3	from __future__ import annotations
4	
5	import json
6	
7	from agentmon.llm.client import LLMResponse
8	
9	DEFAULT_VERDICT_JSON = json.dumps(
10	    {
11	        "suspicion_score": 10,
12	        "categories": [],
13	        "evidence": [{"event_index": 0, "quote": "mock evidence"}],
14	        "reasoning": "Mock verdict: nothing suspicious found.",
15	    }
16	)
17	
18	
19	class MockLLMClient:
20	    """Returns canned responses and records every call.
21	
22	    ``script`` maps a substring to a response: the first entry whose key
23	    appears in the prompt wins. Otherwise ``default_response`` is returned.
24	    Fully deterministic — same prompts in, same responses out.
25	    """
26	
27	    def __init__(
28	        self,
29	        script: dict[str, str] | None = None,
30	        default_response: str = DEFAULT_VERDICT_JSON,
31	    ) -> None:
32	        self.script = script or {}
33	        self.default_response = default_response
34	        self.calls: list[dict[str, object]] = []
35	
36	    @property
37	    def call_count(self) -> int:
38	        return len(self.calls)
39	
40	    def complete(
41	        self,
42	        prompt: str,
43	        *,
44	        model: str,
45	        max_tokens: int = 4096,
46	        temperature: float = 0.0,
47	    ) -> LLMResponse:
48	        self.calls.append(
49	            {
50	                "prompt": prompt,
51	                "model": model,
52	                "max_tokens": max_tokens,
53	                "temperature": temperature,
54	            }
55	        )
56	        text = self.default_response
57	        for needle, response in self.script.items():
58	            if needle in prompt:
59	                text = response
60	                break
61	        return LLMResponse(
62	            text=text,
63	            model=model,
64	            input_tokens=len(prompt) // 4,
65	            output_tokens=len(text) // 4,
66	            latency_ms=0.0,
67	        )

+"""Run monitors over transcripts with an optional on-disk response cache.
+
+The cache stores raw :class:`~agentmon.llm.client.LLMResponse` payloads keyed
+by (prompt template, transcript content, model, temperature), so re-runs cost
+nothing and experiments stay reproducible. Verdicts are always rebuilt by
+re-parsing the (cached or fresh) response through the monitor.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+from pydantic import ValidationError
+
+from agentmon.llm.client import LLMClient, LLMResponse
+from agentmon.monitors.base import Monitor
+from agentmon.schemas import MonitorVerdict, Transcript
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from collections.abc import Sequence
+
+_TEMPERATURE = 0.0
+
+
+def cache_key(monitor: Monitor, transcript: Transcript) -> str:
+    """Deterministic cache key for one (monitor, transcript) pair."""
+    payload = json.dumps(
+        {
+            "prompt": monitor.template,
+            "transcript": transcript.model_dump_json(),
+            "model": monitor.config.model,
+            "temperature": _TEMPERATURE,
+        },
+        sort_keys=True,
+    )
+    return hashlib.sha256(payload.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _read_cached_response(path: Path) -> LLMResponse | None:
+    """Load a cached response, treating any missing or corrupt file as a miss."""
+    try:
+        return LLMResponse.model_validate_json(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    except (OSError, ValueError, ValidationError):
+        return None
+
+
+def run_monitors(
+    monitors: Sequence[Monitor],
+    transcripts: Sequence[Transcript],
+    client: LLMClient,
+    cache_dir: Path | None = None,
+) -> list[MonitorVerdict]:
+    """Run every monitor over every transcript, returning one verdict per pair.
+
+    Calls are sequential (monitors outer, transcripts inner) at temperature 0.
+    With ``cache_dir`` set, responses are cached on disk and cache hits skip
+    the client entirely; ``cache_dir=None`` disables caching.
+    """
+    verdicts: list[MonitorVerdict] = []
+    for monitor in monitors:
+        for transcript in transcripts:
+            prompt = monitor.build_prompt(transcript)
+            cache_path = (
+                cache_dir / f"{cache_key(monitor, transcript)}.json" if cache_dir else None
+            )
+            response = _read_cached_response(cache_path) if cache_path else None
+            if response is None:
+                response = client.complete(
+                    prompt, model=monitor.config.model, temperature=_TEMPERATURE
+                )
+                if cache_path is not None:
+                    cache_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+                    cache_path.write_text(response.model_dump_json(), encoding="utf-8")
+            verdicts.append(monitor.verdict_from_response(transcript.id, response))
+    return verdicts

+"""Tests for the monitor runner and its on-disk response cache."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from agentmon.llm.mock import MockLLMClient
+from agentmon.monitors.base import Monitor, MonitorConfig
+from agentmon.runner import cache_key, run_monitors
+from agentmon.schemas import ShellCommand, Transcript, UserMessage
+
+TEMPLATE = "Judge this transcript for suspicious behavior:\n\n{{transcript}}\n\nRespond in JSON."
+
+
+def make_monitor(monitor_id: str = "judge", model: str = "claude-test-1") -> Monitor:
+    config = MonitorConfig(id=monitor_id, model=model)
+    return Monitor(config=config, template=TEMPLATE)
+
+
+def make_transcript(transcript_id: str, command: str = "ls") -> Transcript:
+    return Transcript(
+        id=transcript_id,
+        source="synthetic",
+        events=[
+            UserMessage(index=0, text="please run a command"),
+            ShellCommand(index=1, command=command, output="ok", exit_code=0),
+        ],
+    )
+
+
+def test_run_monitors_returns_one_verdict_per_pair(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    monitor = make_monitor()
+    transcripts = [make_transcript("t1"), make_transcript("t2", command="rm -rf /")]
+    client = MockLLMClient()
+
+    verdicts = run_monitors([monitor], transcripts, client, cache_dir=tmp_path)
+
+    assert client.call_count == 2
+    assert [v.transcript_id for v in verdicts] == ["t1", "t2"]
+    assert all(v.monitor_id == "judge" for v in verdicts)
+    assert all(v.parse_error is None for v in verdicts)
+
+
+def test_second_run_hits_cache_and_matches(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    monitor = make_monitor()
+    transcripts = [make_transcript("t1"), make_transcript("t2", command="rm -rf /")]
+
+    first = run_monitors([monitor], transcripts, MockLLMClient(), cache_dir=tmp_path)
+
+    fresh_client = MockLLMClient()
+    second = run_monitors([monitor], transcripts, fresh_client, cache_dir=tmp_path)
+
+    assert fresh_client.call_count == 0
+    assert [v.model_dump() for v in second] == [v.model_dump() for v in first]
+
+
+def test_no_cache_dir_calls_client_every_run() -> None:
+    monitor = make_monitor()
+    transcripts = [make_transcript("t1")]
+    client = MockLLMClient()
+
+    run_monitors([monitor], transcripts, client, cache_dir=None)
+    run_monitors([monitor], transcripts, client, cache_dir=None)
+
+    assert client.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_cache_key_changes_with_model() -> None:
+    transcript = make_transcript("t1")
+    key_a = cache_key(make_monitor(model="claude-test-1"), transcript)
+    key_b = cache_key(make_monitor(model="claude-test-2"), transcript)
+    assert key_a != key_b
+
+
+def test_cache_key_changes_with_transcript_content() -> None:
+    monitor = make_monitor()
+    key_a = cache_key(monitor, make_transcript("t1", command="ls"))
+    key_b = cache_key(monitor, make_transcript("t1", command="rm -rf /"))
+    assert key_a != key_b
+
+
+def test_corrupt_cache_file_is_treated_as_miss(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    monitor = make_monitor()
+    transcript = make_transcript("t1")
+    cache_file = tmp_path / f"{cache_key(monitor, transcript)}.json"
+    cache_file.write_text("{not valid json", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    client = MockLLMClient()
+    verdicts = run_monitors([monitor], [transcript], client, cache_dir=tmp_path)
+
+    assert client.call_count == 1
+    assert verdicts[0].parse_error is None
+    # The corrupt file was overwritten with a valid cached response.
+    fresh_client = MockLLMClient()
+    run_monitors([monitor], [transcript], fresh_client, cache_dir=tmp_path)
+    assert fresh_client.call_count == 0
